attested.hardware: one Perlmutter CPU node (AMD EPYC 7763, 128 workers) for the corrected census of the full 4-covers of compressed cat_5, job 59930310, 1261 s wall, 2026-10-18 UTC; two earlier census runs (jobs 59924919 and 59926124, 736 s and 1,120 s) listed a fifth of the covers because their hash functionals wrapped int64 and are superseded; stages beta, B, C and A on an Apple silicon laptop (one core)
attested.note: The census lists every 4-set of four-qubit stabilizer states whose span contains c_5 = cat_5(y, parity(y)) with four nonzero coefficients and independent states, one per orbit of the group generated by permutations of the four qubits, R(x)R on a pair and the parity swap of cat_7 (100 pivot orbits, 2,292,776 pivot pairs, 16,705 covers), stored per work unit (pivot orbit, partner stride class, 1,600 batches) under research/cat7_rank4/results/. The certificate verifies every stored batch hash, re-enumerates two units from scratch (seed 20261017) and compares, then runs the whole exclusion: stages beta (one invisible term), B (dependent bases: none exist), C (a repeated base state) and A (the stored covers), with every candidate completion rebuilt and decided exactly; a decomposition with fewer than four terms would fail the run. The census functionals reduce every product modulo P before summing (research/cat7_rank4/census_control.py plants targets: the corrected functional lists all ten, the wrapped one none). Completeness of the census rests on the stored outputs and on research/cat7_rank4/census4_run.py, which regenerates any unit.
